|game_text=Jabba’s Prize is a Light Side card and does not count towards your deck limit (but subtracts one from the number of cards you may place under your Starting Effect). Reveal to opponent when deploying your Starting Effect. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Maintenance] ''Falcon''. ''Deploys only at start of game if Jabba’s Prize is at Security Tower (replaces opponent’s Jabba’s Prize imprisoned in Security Tower); otherwise place out of play.'' May not be placed in Reserve Deck. Jabba’s Prize is a persona of Corran Horn only while on table. If Jabba’s Prize was just released or leaves table, place it out of play. While Jabba’s Prize is at Audience Chamber, opponent’s battle destiny draws there are +1.
|errata_history={{Card errata/Jabba's Prize}}
This is errata version PC-E3 of [[Jabba's Prize]] (version 4 of 4); it is the current text.
* '''Original''' ([[Jabba's Prize]]): the Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet prints this text as slip 65 (official text as of 4 September 2009).<ref name="jp-sheet">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=9 Players Committee Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet], slip 65, official text dated 4 September 2009. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Jabba's Prize (Errata)]]): the Players Committee website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012<ref name="jp-cardlist">Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html Virtual Block 6 card list], preserved 21 July 2012.</ref>) uses “toward” and “start under,” moves the Falcon clause, and drops “is” before “at Audience Chamber.”
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Jabba's Prize (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee full-card image ([[:File:VB6-L-jabbasprizefront-pre.gif]]), dated by the publisher's image directory to its group upload of 25 February 2013<ref name="jp-imagedir">Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Virtual Block 6 image directory]. The listing dates the full-card image to 25 February 2013.</ref>, has the front text of the release-sheet slip again.
* '''PC-E3''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side, p. 9; official text as of 27 April 2013)<ref name="jp-master">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], p. 9, cover "official text as of April 27, 2013". [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=9 Preserved publisher PDF] (captured 5 July 2017).</ref> repeats the release-sheet wording. It is the latest publication, so it is the current text.
